models_evaluated: nine LLMs including open-source, proprietary, and domain-specific models

links.outcome: LLM versus human annotator accuracy on medical calculator selection questions
links.effect: Best LLM (o1) accuracy 66.0% (CI 56.7-75.3%) on 100 questions vs. two human annotators averaging 79.5% (CI 73.5-85.0%); LLMs not superior to humans.
links.quote: Ultimately, we evaluated medical trainees and LLMs in recommending medical calculators across clinical scenarios like risk stratification and diagnosis.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluation comparing nine LLMs against human clinicians/trainees on recommending clinical medical calculators using multiple-choice questions.
